confirmed_task:
On Debian Packages, open the Bookworm curl package. Report the package version, every architecture listed in the Download curl table, and every required package shown under Depends, including its displayed version constraint.

Stopping condition: Stop after the Bookworm package version, complete architecture list, and all required dependencies have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Do not download or install the package.
- Remain on the Debian Bookworm package page.
- Include only packages under Depends; exclude Recommends, Suggests, and similar optional relationships.

items.criterion: Use the Debian Bookworm curl package page (packages.debian.org/bookworm/curl)
items.description: Agent stays on the Debian Packages Bookworm page for curl and uses it as the sole source. Full credit if the agent clearly bases findings on the Bookworm curl page (whether starting there or navigating there). Partial credit if the agent appears to use another page/source despite the Bookworm page being accessible. Full credit if the agent reports an uncontrollable blocker (site down, access error) that prevents viewing the page content.

items.criterion: Record the Bookworm curl package version
items.description: Report the package version shown for curl on the Bookworm page. Full credit for the exact version string as displayed. Partial credit if the version is incomplete/truncated but clearly identifiable. Full credit if the agent explains inability to retrieve the version due to an uncontrollable page/access issue.

items.criterion: Record all architectures in the 'Download curl' table
items.description: List every architecture shown in the 'Download curl' table on the Bookworm curl page. Full credit only if the architecture list is complete (no missing/extra architectures) and matches the table. Partial credit if most architectures are listed but one or more are missing or one incorrect extra is included. Full credit if the table is not visible due to an uncontrollable issue and the agent reports that limitation.

items.criterion: Record all required dependencies under Depends (with version constraints)
items.description: List every package shown under the 'Depends' section (and only those under Depends), including each displayed version constraint (e.g., ">=", "<", etc.) exactly as shown. Full credit for a complete and accurate Depends list with correct constraints and excluding Recommends/Suggests/Enhances/Pre-Depends/Breaks/Conflicts, etc. Partial credit if: (a) one or more Depends entries are missing, (b) constraints are omitted/mis-copied, or (c) optional relationship packages are incorrectly included. Full credit if the Depends section cannot be accessed due to an uncontrollable blocker and the agent reports the issue clearly.

items.criterion: Respect constraints: no download/install; stop after recording requested items
items.description: Agent does not download or install anything and stops once the Bookworm version, the full architecture list, and all Depends (with constraints) are recorded. Full credit if the agent avoids any downloading/installing and does not add extra unrelated information beyond the requested items. Partial credit if minor extra navigation/output occurs but no download/install happens. No credit if the agent downloads/installs the package or otherwise violates the explicit constraints.
